description: Delete one cookie by name, or every cookie for the current page when name is omitted. Deleting all cookies usually logs the user out and resets consent banners and preferences; it cannot be undone. The page notices on its next request, so refresh (history) or navigate afterwards.

name.description: Name of the cookie to delete, e.g. 'session_id'. Omit to delete ALL cookies for the current page.

name: delete_cookie
